allow_large: The owner approved the v1.2.23 release. The change is the version bump in every pin, installer, plugin and version test, plus the guides that forge sync rewrote because close requires synced guides for a version change

known.title: Gate: release allowance does not cover unrelated guidance changes

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate - allowance reason does not match the whole diff. Case: normal use - merging the approved version-only v1.2.23 release. Both synced standards files add an abstraction policy, and both synced SKILL.md files add sign-off instructions. These changes address guidance rather than release references, so the recorded version-bump allowance does not cover the whole diff. They also contradict the recorded ruling to keep these guides unchanged. Remove these edits from all four files while retaining the release-reference updates.
findings.title: Gate: release allowance does not cover unrelated guidance changes

stop.reason: The allowance now names the synced guides that close required for the version change
